# monitorable_alert_template (Data Source)

Looks up one alert template by `id` or by exact `name`. Fails when the template does not exist. Templates are managed in the dashboard; use the id with `monitorable_server_alert_template`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The name is exact and case-sensitive.
data "monitorable_alert_template" "strict" {
  name = "Strict"
}

resource "monitorable_server" "db" {
  name = "db-01"
}

resource "monitorable_server_alert_template" "db" {
  server_id   = monitorable_server.db.id
  template_id = data.monitorable_alert_template.strict.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The template id, a decimal integer. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) The template's exact name; the match is case-sensitive. It is an error if no template, or more than one, has this name; look it up by `id` in that case. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.

### Read-Only

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization's default template, the one servers follow when none is assigned.
